purpose: Concept, structural design and action sketches for future modeling; not production meshes, animation or validated orthographic blueprints.
constraints: Different dominant palette per species, shared original hand-painted chitin technique.
Five color roles per species, four to six color families allowed; shade variations are not separate families.
Assassin: Alien / StarCraft 奎蛇 / Evolve Wraith direction, forward pounce, wall and ceiling climbing, duct compression.
Scorpion: organic chelae with fixed and movable fingers, swollen palm, irregular denticles, soft joint membrane; no flat shield claws.
notes: Reference paths are relative to this JSON. Existing game art was visually inspected; actual generation reference inputs varied by iteration. Final designs and sketches use the matching final concept PNG as their primary visual reference. Concept iterations superseded the initial shared red-brown palette. Colors are art direction targets rather than pixel-exact quantization.
